title.zh: 授权民政总督为民事公共用途保留并禁止出售或定居尚未依法指定用于特殊公共用途的公有土地，直至法律另行规定，并将第六百二十七号法的条款扩展适用于岛屿政府拟为公共用途保留的公地或拟为该用途购置的私地，使其纳入土地登记法适用范围的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CIVIL GOVERNOR TO RESERVE FOR CIVIL PUBLIC PURPOSES, AND FROM SALE OR SETTLEMENT, ANY PART OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN NOT APPROPRIATED BY LAW FOR SPECIAL PUBLIC PURPOSES, UNTIL OTHERWISE DIRECTED BY LAW, AND EXTENDING THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN SO THAT PUBLIC LANDS DESIRED TO BE RESERVED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT FOR PUBLIC USES, OR PRIVATE LANDS DESIRED TO BE PURCHASED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT FOR SUCH USES, MAY BE BROUGHT UNDER THE OPERATION OF THE LAND REGISTRATION ACT.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CIVIL GOVERNOR TO RESERVE FOR CIVIL PUBLIC PURPOSES, AND FROM SALE OR SETTLEMENT, ANY PART OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN NOT APPROPRIATED BY LAW FOR SPECIAL PUBLIC PURPOSES, UNTIL OTHERWISE DIRECTED BY LAW, AND EXTENDING THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN SO THAT PUBLIC LANDS DESIRED TO BE RESERVED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT FOR PUBLIC USES, OR PRIVATE LANDS DESIRED TO BE PURCHASED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT FOR SUCH USES, MAY BE BROUGHT UNDER THE OPERATION OF THE LAND REGISTRATION ACT.
title.vi: Đạo luật ủy quyền cho Thống đốc Dân sự dự trữ một phần Vùng Đất Công chưa được pháp luật dành riêng cho các mục đích công cộng đặc biệt để phục vụ các mục đích công cộng dân sự và ngăn cấm việc bán hay định cư trên vùng đất đó cho đến khi có quy định khác của pháp luật, đồng thời mở rộng phạm vi áp dụng của Đạo luật Số 627 để các vùng đất công mà Chính phủ Đảo muốn dành cho mục đích công cộng hoặc các vùng đất tư mà Chính phủ Đảo muốn mua cho mục đích đó được đưa vào phạm vi điều chỉnh của Đạo luật Đăng ký Đất đai
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติมอบอำนาจแก่ผู้ว่าราชการพลเรือนในการสงวนที่ดินของแผ่นดินสำหรับวัตถุประสงค์สาธารณะทางพลเรือนและจากการขายหรือการตั้งถิ่นฐานส่วนใดส่วนหนึ่งของที่ดินของแผ่นดินที่ยังไม่ได้ถูกจัดสรรโดยกฎหมายเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์สาธารณะพิเศษจนกว่าจะมีบทบัญญัติอื่นของกฎหมายกำหนดไว้เป็นอย่างอื่นและขยายบทบัญญัติของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่หกร้อยยี่สิบเจ็ดเพื่อให้ที่ดินของแผ่นดินที่รัฐบาลเกาะประสงค์จะสงวนไว้เพื่อการใช้สาธารณะหรือที่ดินเอกชนที่รัฐบาลเกาะประสงค์จะซื้อเพื่อการใช้ดังกล่าวเข้าภายใต้บังคับของพระราชบัญญัติการจดทะเบียนที่ดิน
title.id: Undang-Undang Memberikan Wewenang kepada Gubernur Sipil untuk Menyisihkan Sebagian dari Wilayah Tanah Umum yang Belum Dialokasikan oleh Undang-Undang untuk Tujuan Publik Khusus guna Tujuan Publik Sipil dan dari Penjualan atau Pemukiman, Sampai Diarahkan Lain oleh Undang-Undang, serta Memperluas Ketentuan Undang-Undang Nomor Enam Ratus Dua Puluh Tujuh agar Tanah Umum yang Ingin Disisihkan oleh Pemerintah Insular untuk Penggunaan Publik, atau Tanah Swasta yang Ingin Dibeli oleh Pemerintah Insular untuk Penggunaan Tersebut, Dapat Dikenakan oleh Undang-Undang Pendaftaran Tanah
title.ms: Akta Memberi Kuasa kepada Gabenor Awam untuk Menyisihkan Sebahagian daripada Tanah Kerajaan yang Belum Diperuntukkan oleh Undang-Undang bagi Tujuan Awam Khas bagi Tujuan Awam Awam dan daripada Jualan atau Penempatan sehingga diarahkan lain oleh Undang-Undang dan Melanjutkan Ketentuan Akta Nombor Enam Ratus Dua Puluh Tujuh supaya Tanah Kerajaan yang Hendak Disisihkan oleh Kerajaan Insular bagi Kegunaan Awam atau Tanah Persendirian yang Hendak Dibeli oleh Kerajaan Insular bagi Kegunaan tersebut boleh Dikenakan di bawah Akta Pendaftaran Tanah

text.en:
The Civil Governor is hereby authorized and empowered by executive order to reserve from
settlement or public sale and for specific public uses any of the public domain of the Philippine Islands the
use of which is not otherwise directed by law; and thereafter such land shall not be subject to settlement or
sale and shall be used for the specific purposes directed by such executive order until otherwise provided by

Whenever the Civil Governor, in writing, shall certify that all public lands within limits by him
described in the Philippine Islands are reserved for civil public uses, either of the Insular Government or of
any provincial or municipal government, and shall give notice thereof to the judge of the Court of Land
Registration, it shall be the duty of the judge of said court to proceed to issue notice thereof and that claims
for all private lands, buildings and interest therein, within said limits must be presented for registration under
the Land Registration Act in the manner provided in Act Numbered Six hundred and twenty-seven, entitled
"An Act to bring immediately under the operation of the Land Registration Act all lands lying within the
boundaries lawfully set apart for military reservations, and all lands desired to be purchased by the
Government of the United States for military purposes." The procedure for the purpose of this Act and the
legal effects thereof shall thereupon be in all respects as provided in sections three, four, five, and six of said
Act Numbered Six hundred and twenty-seven.

Whenever the Civil Governor shall certify that the civil authorities, either insular, provincial, or
municipal, wish to acquire by purchase for public use property owned by private individuals in the
Philippine Islands, and not within the boundaries of public lands set apart for such use in accordance with the
preceding section, and shall describe specifically the land so desired to be purchased, and further certify that
the titles to the same are so uncertain that it is impracticable to determine who are the true individual owners
thereof, it shall be the duty of the judge of the Court of Land Registration upon receipt of such certification
to proceed to bring the lands mentioned forthwith under the operation of the Land Registration Act in the
manner and with the legal effect provided in section seven of said Act Numbered Six hundred and twenty-

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 3, 1903.
